title: Possible bug with incorrect types in `generateText` result - `providerOptions` vs `providerMetadata`
body:
### Description

The interface `GenerateTextResult` claims that the `reasoning` is `Array<ReasoningPart>`.
In turn, `ReasoningPart` is defined as:

```
/**
 * Reasoning content part of a prompt. It contains a reasoning.
 */
export interface ReasoningPart {
  type: 'reasoning';

  /**
The reasoning text.
   */
  text: string;

  /**
Additional provider-specific metadata. They are passed through
to the provider from the AI SDK and enable provider-specific
functionality that can be fully encapsulated in the provider.
 */
  providerOptions?: ProviderOptions;
}
```

However, I've observed cases where the output actually contains `providerMetadata` instead of `providerOptions`. 

I am able to consistently reproduce this with 1) Claude 4 Sonnet, 2) extended thinking on and 3) tools enabled.

### AI SDK Version

"@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock": "^3.0.16",
"@ai-sdk/anthropic": "^2.0.12",
"@ai-sdk/azure": "^2.0.24",
"@ai-sdk/google": "^2.0.12",
"@ai-sdk/google-vertex": "^3.0.20",
"@ai-sdk/openai": "^2.0.24",
"ai": "^5.0.33",

linked_prs.title: fix(ai): use correct type for reasoning outputs
linked_prs.body:
## Background

The types for the reasoning output are wrong, we used reasoning input types (see #8589 )

## Summary

* introduce `ReasoningOutput` type and update streamText/generateText result types.

## Manual Verification

* [x] verified in example that `providerMetadata` is used on reasoning parts of generateText result

## Future Work

Move to explicit `*Output` types for outputs.

## Related Issues

Fixes #8589

Yes.  
This issue references LLM providers (Claude 4 Sonnet, Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), involves provider-specific metadata in the agent's reasoning output, and concerns SDK integration and result structure, which are agent-specific components per the taxonomy (Incompatibility with LLM providers: Incompatible parameters, Unsupported models).
